normal_step_scope: Arithmetic mean and median of the existing positive one-second decode windows, excluding the fixed-output windows; output lengths and hashes may differ. The legacy ordinary window series omits zero-step stalls. Equivalent ms/step is the reciprocal of this window mean, not mean measured latency. This is not a pooled rate or an isolated kernel speedup.
